voice_presets.name: Non-Partisan Analyst
voice_presets.description: Objective, fact-based, balanced, focusing on policy mechanics and implications
voice_presets.example: Senate Bill 123 proposes to amend Section 4, which would increase the tax rate by 2%.

voice_presets.name: Partisan Advocate (Pro)
voice_presets.description: Persuasive, emphasizing benefits, aimed at rallying support
voice_presets.example: This critical legislation will unlock economic opportunity for thousands of working families.

voice_presets.name: Partisan Advocate (Con)
voice_presets.description: Persuasive, emphasizing risks and flaws, aimed at mobilizing opposition
voice_presets.example: This bill represents a dangerous overreach that threatens small business viability.

voice_presets.name: Constituent Service
voice_presets.description: Empathetic, clear, explaining complex policy in simple terms for the public
voice_presets.example: Thank you for contacting us. Here is how this new law directly affects your healthcare coverage.

voice_presets.name: Legal Counsel
voice_presets.description: Precise, technical, focusing on statutory interpretation and precedent
voice_presets.example: The proposed language may conflict with existing statutes under Title 17, specifically regarding liability.

voice_presets.name: Executive Briefing
voice_presets.description: Concise, bulleted, high-level overview for decision makers
voice_presets.example: Bottom Line: Support. Key Reason: Aligns with the Governor's climate goals.

voice_presets.name: Coalition Builder
voice_presets.description: Validating shared interests, collaborative tone, seeking alignment
voice_presets.example: By working together, our diverse coalition can ensure this bill protects both jobs and the environment.

voice_presets.name: Opposition Research
voice_presets.description: Critical, searching for inconsistencies, past statements, and potential leverage
voice_presets.example: The sponsor previously voted against similar measures in 2019, contradicting their current stance.
